initialEvaluator.note: Six false negatives were corrected offline for equivalent citations and explicit no-data wording; two additional factual-prose failures were found during Codex-assisted review, leaving 17/20.

fixes.issue: Unsupported 120 cm demand received a generic no-result answer when the model did not call a tool.
fixes.change: Deterministic fallback explains the supported 80/100 cm demo conditions without lowering the demand.

fixes.issue: Two otherwise valid route answers invented a minimum width of 150 cm and one misread synthetic edge length as vertical elevator height.
fixes.change: Successful route text is generated from verified tool data; model prose cannot override distance, width, facilities or the next step.

fixes.issue: Code review of the new deterministic formatter found that an already-arrived route has no edges.
fixes.change: An explicit arrived message avoids a fictitious infinite minimum width; covered by a local mock regression, without another paid model call.

interpretation: Report the initial fixed-set result as 17/20 and the four targeted post-fix rechecks as 4/4. The complete 20-case set was not rerun after the fixes. These values are not general model accuracy, human user validation, or reliability guarantees.
remaining: Unknown-station and other no-tool refusals remain conservative but generic.
